question: Each of A, B, C, D, E, F and G has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week, C has the exam on Tuesday. Only one person has the exam between A and G, A has exam before G. D has the exam on the day immediately before A, but not on Thursday. F's exam is on one of the days before E but after B. E has exam on Sunday. Who among the following has the exam on Monday?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) C has the exam on Tuesday.

2) E has exam on Sunday.
